sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the appellants and learned AGA for the State.
2.
As per office report, it is apparent that notice has already been served upon respondent no. 2.

In spite of service of notice, none appeared on behalf of respondent no. 2.
3.

The instant appeal has been preferred for challenging the summoning order passed on dated 27.07.2022 by Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Gorakhpur in Complaint Case No. 144 of 2019 (Kamlawati Vs. Indra Dev and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 106 of 2013 under Sections 376-D, 506 IPC & Section 3(2)(5) SC/ST Act, PS Chauri Chaura, District Gorakhpur Shiv Lal Gupta @ Shiv Lal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105022358/
1 preferred at the behest of opposite party/respondent no. 2.
4.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Gorakhpur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Complaint Case No. 144 of 2019 (Kamlawati Vs. Indra Dev and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for appellants pressed all the grounds whatsoever has been taken through the instant criminal appeal through which, it has been apprised that there is hardly any attraction of sections in which the appellants have been summoned and all these grounds have not been taken into consideration while passing the order dated 27.07.2022.
5. Learned AGA vehemently opposed the prayer sought through the instant appeal.

6. Be that as it may, no useful purpose shall be served by way of giving time for exchange of counter and rejoinder affidavit and keeping the matter pending before this Court once no one is appearing at the behest of respondent no. 2.
7.

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, learned Court of Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Gorakhpur is hereby directed to proceed with Complaint Case no.
144 of 2019 (Kamlawati Vs. Indra Dev and others) and expedite and finalize it preferably within a year from the date of presentation of certified copy of this order before him without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.

entities.text: Court of Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Gorakhpur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Kamlawati Vs. Indra Dev and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Learned counsel for appellants assures on behalf of the appellants that they will fully cooperate with the learned trial court concerned for expeditious disposal of the said complaint case.
9. However, it is made clear that till the pendency of the above mentioned complaint case no coercive action shall be initiated against the appellants.
10. The instant appeal is hereby disposed of accordingly.
